meta.name: MedLoop chronic-care drug interaction reference
meta.scope: Common chronic-disease medicines (diabetes, hypertension, cardiac, lipid, thyroid) and frequently co-prescribed drugs in India
meta.disclaimer: Starter reference compiled from general, widely published clinical knowledge. Must be reviewed by a qualified pharmacist or physician before use with real patients. Output is a flag for the care team, not medical advice.
